THIS REVIEW PETITION HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 07.10.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 RP NO. 1300 OF 2025 IN LA.App. NO.103 OF 2025 3 2025:KER:75134  ORDER A.Muhamed Mustaque, J.
This Review Petition is filed by the State.

This Court had condoned the delay of 1612 days in filing the appeal without taking note that the acquisition proceedings were initiated under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation &
Resettlement Act, 2013 ('RFCTLARR Act' in short).

sentences.text: There is no provision to condone a delay beyond 60 days.
Therefore, there is an apparent mistake in condoning the delay.

Accordingly, this Review petition is allowed.
